trial_court: Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Patna City in Complaint Case No.703C of 2016
case_name: Aruna Devi & Ors vs State Of Bihar & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Aruna Devi, Wife of Late Sukhdeo Prasad Verma and others (family members)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Bihar and Punam Verma, Wife of Jay Kumar Verma

facts_of_case: Complainant-opposite party no.2 was married to Jay Kumar Verma and alleged cruelty by husband and relatives after she refused to make a demand for Rs.2,00,000/- and a motorcycle from her parents.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the complainant to prove the allegations made in the complaint.
legal_principles.held: It has been submitted by Mr. Devendra Kumar Sinha, learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioners that in the present case there is no specific allegation of any overt act against the petitioners who are relatives of the husband of the complainant.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not interdict criminal proceedings at the initial stage.
legal_principles.held: He submitted that it would not be proper to interdict the criminal proceeding at the initial stage.
cited_cases: Aruna Devi & Ors vs State Of Bihar & Anr, (2018)

outcome.final_order: The order summoning the petitioners to face trial was quashed.
